raw.title: Bump content-type from 2.0.0 to 3.0.0
raw.body:
Bumps [content-type](https://github.com/jshttp/content-type) from 2.0.0 to 3.0.0.
Release notes

Sourced from content-type's releases.

v3.0.0

This is an ESM only release. The API is unchanged since the latest 2.x release.

Changed

  • Publish as ESM (jshttp/content-type#74)

v2.1.0

Added

  • Parse up to comma with comma: true (#72) 181e947

https://github.com/jshttp/content-type/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
